title: Mack Superliner Custom Built Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #6
description: Mack superliner FUPS Bullbar. Cow catcher and gussets behind cow catcher. Steel plate over tow hitch can be painted black or your chassis colour or chrome. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia. available. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification. Indicator and daylight running lights in channel. Extra heavy duty steel backing plate and tow pin.
